entries.text: You see Set, the Leader of Necropolis.
entries.source_text: You see Set, the Leader of Necropolis.

entries.text: There'd better be a killer reason for standin' in my shadow. Does 'next on the menu' ring a bell for ya . . . normie.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: Well. I see some potential here . . . heh . . . I have playmates for you, my sparkling normie. Punish the mutants at the water shed for me. Yeah, yeah, can do . . . yes?

entries.text: Excellent. Teach those mutants the last lesson, then amble back . . . Hmm. If I say to my ghouls to hold off you, the muties might hear and know. So I tell you what, it's favor-time. I keep shut. Got it?

entries.text: The Necropolis was mine. Not an all-things-great, but a straight-place for my kind. Then the Master showed. He could've fragged me good, but it was easy for him to just stand some muties and keep an eye on.

entries.text: My name's Set. Yours is World-a-hurt. Take a deal, I change your handle. Listening?

entries.text: Uh-huh.

entries.text: Nuh-uh!

You sound a little scared by these guys, want to

entries.source_text: You look funny, and you talk funny.
